title: grindelia hirsutula var. revoluta
intro: Grindelia hirsutula var. revoluta, commonly known as Wild Gum Weed, is a plant species in the sunflower family. This plant is traditionally used for its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Wild Gum Weed include reducing inflammation and relieving congestion, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an expectorant and bronchodilator. The bioactive constituents of Grindelia hirsutula var. revoluta include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
